title: Tainted Love
overview: Greg Page returns to his hometown hoping to leave his troubled past behind, only to reunite with his former love, Emily Marshall (Chloe Marshall). As old feelings reignite, they uncover a web of deception orchestrated by influential businessman Raj Maran (Nirmal Kumar Marimuthu), who has spent years keeping them apart. With the help of investigative journalist Daniel Cross (Lee Cullwell) and loyal friend Ethan Liu (Alan Liu), Greg pieces together the truth behind the lies that destroyed their relationship. As Raj's secrets unravel, the group faces betrayal, danger, and impossible choices. In the end, justice comes at a cost, but Greg and Emily are given one final chance to reclaim the love that was stolen from them.
